source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value:
                colors.setdefault(value, []).append((r, c))
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target_top = min(r for cells in colors.values() for r, c in cells)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells in colors.items():
        shift = min(r for r, c in cells) - target_top
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r - shift][c] = color
    return out
'''
